title: Towards Fair In-Context Learning with Tabular Foundation Models
reasoning: The paper's core contribution is the investigation, evaluation, and mitigation of bias in AI models. It focuses on enforcing fairness, which is a key ethical principle. The work revolves around operationalizing fairness metrics (demographic parity, equalized odds) and proposing methods to improve them. This constitutes an evaluation and enhancement of a model's ethical performance, going significantly beyond a brief, cursory 'Ethical Considerations' section.
